tools.description: Compile and atomically replace this session's typed positive rule program; replay retained facts. Unsupported syntax is rejected.
tools.name: lemmalog_install_rules

tools.description: Transactionally insert or delete input facts with set semantics.
tools.name: apply_changes

tools.description: Dump a declared output relation at the last completed transaction. Returns DDlog row text.
tools.name: lemmalog_query

tools.description: Read direct variable-binding witnesses for a zero-based rule index. Not recursive provenance.
tools.name: lemmalog_why

tools.description: Discover operator-registered operations. Each takes and returns a string; providers execute outside DDlog.
tools.name: agent_operations

tools.description: Select a registered operation. Author rules consuming agent_result(entity:string, revision:int, output:string). The runtime generates private request/response relations and freshness joins.
tools.name: install_agent_program

tools.description: Submit a versioned input; identity includes operation version, entity, revision and exact payload. Same revision cannot change payload.
tools.name: submit_agent_input

tools.description: Admit external work once per session. Stale or already claimed requests are rejected. No automatic replay after uncertain outcomes.
tools.name: claim_agent_request

tools.description: Record the external worker's response. Stale replies are retained but never join current outputs; conflicting responses are rejected.
tools.name: complete_agent_request

tools.description: Inspect per-request identity, status and freshness. State is session-local, not durable.
tools.name: agent_request_status
